proposal.rationale: The supplied reviewed primitives support the existing single numeric.search-seed step and result export, but the requested predecessor carry-through wiring introduces an additional root input/output path that is not expressible as a complete supported future graph without inventing an unreviewed carry mechanism or changing the selected baseline semantics. Given the exact tool bindings and the instruction to avoid inventing capabilities, the supportable action is to abstain rather than fabricate a graph.
